events.title: Canadian airline WestJet agrees to settle flight attendants’ sexual harassment class action
events.description: Female staff alleged company failed to maintain safe workplace, after allegations of sexual assault against pilot The Canadian airline WestJet has agreed to pay C$4.5m (£2.4m) to settle a decade-long sexual harassment class action lawsuit levelled by its female flight attendants, who alleged the company failed to maintain a safe workplace. The suit followed allegations by Mandalena Lewis, a former flight attendant, that a pilot had sexually assaulted her and a colleague, but that WestJet kept the pilot flying, thereby putting other employees at risk. events.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
events.description: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.

events.title: Photos: See the best photos from this year's total solar eclipse
events.description: Millions of people in Europe stepped outside Wednesday to watch a spectacular sunset with a solar eclipse. The path of totality passed through portions of Greenland, Iceland, Spain and Portugal.

events.title: Why women are breaking men's endurance records
events.description: Sophie Woods has completed the 2,000-kilometer Via Alpina faster even than the fastest-ever man. DW explains why she is not the only woman breaking men's records in extreme sports.

events.title: Hunger stones: The history behind 'if you see me, weep'
events.description: Centuries-old hunger stones are emerging as Europe's rivers recede. Among the most famous is the Decin hunger stone in the Elbe River with its cryptic message.

events.title: Can childhood trauma be prevented with a drug?
events.description: Researchers in Munich and Stockholm blocked the lifelong social cost of early adversity in mice with a single compound. The catch: it only worked when given during the trauma, not after.

events.title: Kennedy Center board approves Trump name on facade, renovation plan
events.description: The move appears designed to circumvent a judge's ruling that the US president's name should be removed, potentially setting the stage for a new legal fight over the Kennedy Center's name and future.

events.title: Israeli military moves as settlers besiege 3 West Bank homes
events.description: Israel's military has moved to try to stop a group of settlers from besieging three homes in the occupied West Bank. One was owned by a Palestinian American, prompting an unusually sharp rebuke from the US ambassador.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Israeli military moves as settlers besiege 3 West Bank homes

events.title: How Germany's drone defense fails
events.description: Drone defense is a priority for the German government. The latest dramatic incident involving an explosive-laden drone at Leipzig airport shows there are still substantial shortcomings.

events.title: Germany: Buildings evacuated over suspected explosive
events.description: Rail traffic was suspended in a region of Bavaria and authorities evacuated buildings around a train station after a suspicious object was found on the tracks. Police later confirmed it did not contain explosives.

events.title: Israeli settlers seize Palestinian water source in occupied West Bank to create recreational pool
events.description: Israeli settlers have taken control of a freshwater spring that Palestinian farmers in the occupied West Bank have relied on for generations, diverting its water to create a pool at an archaeological site advertised as a tourist attraction and leaving crops to wither. It is estimated that Israeli settlers have now seized control of 95 percent of the northern Jordan Valley's springs, pushing Palestinian communities off their land.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Israeli settlers seize Palestinian water source in occupied West Bank to create recreational pool

events.title: Revealed: What caused man to be partially sucked out of plane
events.description: A shattered window through which a passenger was partially sucked out during a Ryanair flight last month was caused by broken engine parts, US investigators have said.

events.title: Putin sends Trump a gift - and will hope for something in return
events.description: When Russia releases an American citizen from prison, the US normally hands someone over in return.

events.title: US missionary kidnapped in Niger is released after 9 months in captivity
events.description: An American missionary who was kidnapped in Niger in October has been released

events.title: Nigel Farage beats Count Binface in widely mocked election
events.description: Nigel Farage beat trash-can wearing comic candidate Count Binface on Friday, regaining a seat in Parliament he quit a month ago to trigger the widely mocked special election

events.title: Authorities in Vietnam discover more than a ton of concealed ivory illegally shipped from Africa
events.description: Vietnamese authorities have seized a large shipment of ivory illegally shipped from Africa

events.title: A British firm starts containment of oil spill from stricken tanker off Oman
events.description: A British maritime company has been hired to salvage a grounded Russian tanker off Oman and stop a spreading oil spill

events.title: Youth advocates gather in New York to launch new AI standards
events.description: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly transforms everything from how we learn, to the job market, children are adopting the technology more than three times faster than adults – exposing them to unique opportunities and risks.

events.title: Alex Murdaugh makes 'explosive' bid to blow up murder case hinging on DNA, dirty money and lies: expert
events.description: Dick Harpootlian seeks dismissal of Alex Murdaugh's murder indictments, alleging false evidence was presented to the grand jury that charged him.

events.title: Overturned cars shut down multiple 405 Freeway lanes in West Los Angeles during morning commute
events.description: California Highway Patrol closed three Los Angeles 405 Freeway lanes as crews worked to clear two overturned cars near Santa Monica Boulevard.

events.title: Florida father gunned down while intervening in fight after dropping daughter off for first day of school
events.description: Daryl Hill, described by the Orange County Sheriff's Office as a "Good Samaritan," was shot in Apopka, Florida, after intervening in a fight, police said.

events.title: Postpartum mom Lindsay Clancy on trial for murder brings court to a halt with sudden breakdown
events.description: Lindsay Clancy sobbed and said "I can't do this" as a medical examiner described the autopsy of her 5-year-old daughter Cora in court Wednesday.

events.title: New power axis in the making? Three military heavyweights lock arms, complicating Abraham Accords strategy
events.description: The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan raises questions about whether it signals a Middle East shift from the U.S.

events.title: North Korea launches another ballistic missile as US, South Korea prepare for military drills
events.description: North Korea's second ballistic missile launch in less than a week comes as the U.S. and South Korea prepare for Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 North Korea launches another ballistic missile as US, South Korea prepare for military drills

events.title: Taliban wipes out decades of progress as 2.4M Afghan girls remain locked out of school, UN agency says
events.description: UNESCO says 2.4 million Afghan girls are locked out of secondary school five years after the Taliban banned female education beyond the primary level.

events.title: Israel vindicated by Gaza nutrition data after ‘blood libel’ starvation claims, UN envoy says
events.description: A United Nations-backed survey found no widespread acute malnutrition in Gaza, prompting Israel's ambassador to call prior famine claims a blood libel.
